title: SharePoint Online & OneDrive → Google Drive / Shared Drives Migration
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Move files and shares to Drive without losing permissions
problem: SharePoint sites and OneDrive content don't map one-to-one to Google Drive — permissions, sharing, and structure are where these migrations go wrong. This solution migrates SharePoint Online and OneDrive to Google Drive and Shared Drives with a deliberate content/permission mapping, tooling pattern, and per-item validation, so files land in the right shared drives with the right access, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the SPO/OneDrive → Drive/Shared Drives mapping model (sites→shared drives, permissions/sharing translation, structure) and the deployment model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source SPO/OneDrive access, Google tenant/licensing, a migration tool, mapping decisions, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact steps to define the content + permission mapping, run a named pilot, validate files/permissions/sharing, then migrate by wave and validate.
5 supporting scripts — source content/permission discovery, per-item migration + permission validation, a migration coverage/exception report, safe remediation, and a wave target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (files migrated, permissions correct, sharing works) plus Best Practices for shared-drive structure.
short: Migrate SharePoint Online and OneDrive to Google Drive / Shared Drives with deliberate content + permission mapping and per-item validation — files land with the right access, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
